name: app-lavender-award-laurel-recognition-slide
title: Lavender Award Laurel Slide
whatItIs: A lavender slide with a faint portrait in the background and centred navy laurel branches framing a serif award title 'Future of Ageing Awards, Winner 2024' with short body text below.
whatItMeans: Laurels and a refined serif convey prestige gently, and the washed-out photo keeps it warm and human.
techniques: Laurel wreath as the frame for a title
Serif type in navy and white for hierarchy
Heavily tinted photo as a background texture
Small body text fading into the tint

vocabulary.definition: A pair of leaf branches signalling achievement.
A photo overlaid with a single colour wash.
Elements arranged symmetrically on a central axis.
